firstPlayerRule: Whoever last pondered murder starts as the Conductor.
clarifications: Everyone else splits into two teams. The Conductor chooses which track the trolley will take after the teams make their cases.
The player to the left of the Conductor becomes the next Conductor.
internalEvidence: Rendered all four pages. Page 1 gives the pondering criterion and Conductor role; page 3 gives the track choice and leftward handoff. Page 4 credits Explosm and Skybound ©2019 with 2020 and 2021 reprint notes. Track mat and Innocent, Guilty and Modifier cards match inventory BGG 282171. SHA-256: 265f7ca49f24acfc2745b083bf619d1aa2f4dfb3402555e02f46729cd6b52512. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The rules do not specify how to compare or break ties between the most recent thoughts.
The first player is a decision-making role; teams prepare the tracks before the Conductor decides.
